## Panel a

```{r, echo=T,eval=T,fig.width=24,fig.height=12}

# ============================================================
# Fig2/code/Figure2_panelA_complete.R
#
# STATUS: Panel A only (IHC marker heatmap, PRISMA-high vs -low).
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(pals)
library(viridis)

source("Figure1/00_colors.R") ###Re-use colors from Figure1
source("Figure2/02_load_data.R")

#Marker list + Log2FC / p-value computation
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------

MARKER_COLS_EXPECTED <- c("CD20", "MUM1 IgG", "MUM1 IgA", "CD3", "CD8",
                          "Ki67 PD1", "CD163", "CD66b", "CD4 Foxp3",
                          "CD68", "Lag3", "PD1", "PDL1 IC")

compute_log2fc_and_pvalues <- function(meta, marker_cols, group_col = "PRISMA") {
  
  d <- meta %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(ID, all_of(group_col), all_of(marker_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(marker_cols), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(value = value + 1) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  stats_per_marker <- sapply(marker_cols, function(m) {
    v_hi <- d$value[d$variable == m & d[[group_col]] == "PRISMA-high"]
    v_lo <- d$value[d$variable == m & d[[group_col]] == "PRISMA-low"]
    log2fc <- log2(median(v_hi, na.rm = TRUE) / median(v_lo, na.rm = TRUE))
    pval   <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(v_hi, v_lo)$p.value)
    c(log2FC = log2fc, pval = pval)
  })
  
  list(
    Log2FC_filtered             = stats_per_marker["log2FC", ],
    pvalues_ihc_prisma_filtered = stats_per_marker["pval", ]
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Panel A: IHC marker heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_panel_a <- function(meta, min_markers = 7) {
  
  marker_cols <- intersect(MARKER_COLS_EXPECTED, colnames(meta))
  missing <- setdiff(MARKER_COLS_EXPECTED, marker_cols)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    warning("Marker(s) not found in Figure2_metaDat, excluded: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # --- 
  dup_ids <- meta$ID[duplicated(meta$ID)]
  if (length(dup_ids) > 0) {
    dup_rows <- meta[meta$ID %in% dup_ids, c("ID", "CollectionType", "LesionCategory", "AnatomicalOrigin")]
    print(dup_rows[order(dup_rows$ID), ])
    stop(
      length(unique(dup_ids)), " error"
    )
  }
  
  rownames(meta) <- meta$ID
  
  n_non_na <- rowSums(!is.na(meta[, marker_cols]))
  to_keep  <- rownames(meta)[n_non_na > min_markers]
  
  mat <- log2(as.matrix(meta[to_keep, marker_cols]) + 1)
  to_keep_sorted <- to_keep[order(meta[to_keep, "PRISMA"])]
  mat <- mat[to_keep_sorted, , drop = FALSE]
  
  fc_stats <- compute_log2fc_and_pvalues(meta[to_keep, ], marker_cols)
  Log2FC_filtered             <- fc_stats$Log2FC_filtered[marker_cols]
  pvalues_ihc_prisma_filtered <- fc_stats$pvalues_ihc_prisma_filtered[marker_cols]
  
  bar_cols <- rep(viridis(10)[1], length(pvalues_ihc_prisma_filtered))
  bar_cols[pvalues_ihc_prisma_filtered < 0.05] <- viridis(10)[10]
  
  annotation <- meta[to_keep_sorted, c("PRISMA", "CollectionType", "LesionCategory", "AnatomicalOrigin")]
  
  ha_colors <- list(
    PRISMA           = prisma_ihc_colors,
    CollectionType   = collection_type_colors,
    LesionCategory   = lesion_category_colors,
    AnatomicalOrigin = anatomical_origin_colors,
    TLS              = tls_cat_colors,
    TLS_immature     = tls_cat_colors,
    TLS_PFL          = tls_cat_colors,
    TLS_SFL          = tls_cat_colors,
    TLS_NA           = tls_cat_colors
  )
  
  ha_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    simple_anno_size_adjust = TRUE,
    PRISMA           = annotation$PRISMA,
    CollectionType   = annotation$CollectionType,
    LesionCategory   = annotation$LesionCategory,
    AnatomicalOrigin = annotation$AnatomicalOrigin,
    TLS              = meta[to_keep_sorted, "tls_cat_TC_IM_new"],
    TLS_immature     = meta[to_keep_sorted, "Nb_TLS_immature_cat"],
    TLS_PFL          = meta[to_keep_sorted, "Nb_TLS_PFL_cat"],
    TLS_SFL          = meta[to_keep_sorted, "Nb_TLS_SFL_cat"],
    TLS_NA           = meta[to_keep_sorted, "Nb_TLS_NA_cat"],
    col = ha_colors, border = TRUE, gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.3)
  )
  
  ha_right <- rowAnnotation(Log2FC = anno_barplot(Log2FC_filtered, gp = gpar(fill = bar_cols)))
  
  dend_height <- unit(0.33, "cm")
  
  Heatmap(
    t(scale(mat)), name = "mat",
    show_column_names = FALSE, clustering_method_rows = "complete",
    right_annotation = ha_right, top_annotation = ha_top,
    cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = TRUE,
    row_dend_width = dend_height, column_dend_height = dend_height,
    column_split = annotation$PRISMA, column_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
    border = TRUE
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# usage
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 meta <- load_figure2_data("Figure2/Figure2_metaDat.csv")
# pdf("Fig2/output/panel_a.pdf", width = 15, height = 4)
 plot_panel_a(meta)
# dev.off()



```

## Panel b

```{r,echo=T,eval=T}
# Fig2/code/panel_b_tls_counts.R
# Panel B: TLS in TC / Total TLS / Immature TLS / Mature TLS,
# PRISMA-high vs PRISMA-low, log-scaled counts with medians.
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)

source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure2/02_load_data.R")   # for load_figure2_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")

TLS_VARS <- c("New_TLS_TC", "New_TLS_TC_IM", "Nb_TLS_immature", "Nb_TLS_mature")
TLS_LABELS <- c("TLS in TC", "Total TLS", "Immature TLS", "Mature TLS")

plot_panel_b <- function(meta) {
  
  df_m <- meta %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%    # safety net; Figure2_metaDat is already 1 row/patient
    select(ID, PRISMA, all_of(TLS_VARS)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(TLS_VARS), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      value      = as.numeric(value),
      value_log  = value + 1,
      variable   = factor(variable, levels = TLS_VARS, labels = TLS_LABELS)
    ) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  color_groups  <- prisma_ihc_colors
  color_groupsb <- setNames(adjustcolor(color_groups, alpha.f = 0.3), names(color_groups))
  
  median_df <- df_m %>%
    group_by(variable, PRISMA) %>%
    summarise(
      median_raw  = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_plot = median(value_log, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  ggplot(df_m, aes(x = PRISMA, y = value_log, color = PRISMA, fill = PRISMA)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                 outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(data = median_df,
              aes(x = PRISMA, y = median_plot, label = round(median_raw, 1)),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4, fontface = "bold", vjust = -0.5, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
    stat_compare_means(aes(label = after_stat(p.format)), label.x.npc = "center", method = "wilcox.test") +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaks(), labels = prettyNum) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_groupsb) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    ylab("Count + 1") + xlab("") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold")
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
}

# --- usage ---
 meta <- load_figure2_data("Figure2/Figure2_metaDat.csv")
 plot_panel_b(meta)
```

## Panel c

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.width=16,fig.height=12}
# ============================================================
# Fig2/code/panel_c_ihc_response_by_arm.R
# Panel C: TLS/marker counts by response (R/NR), split by arm,
# one facet per TLS variable/marker (17 total).

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2) 

source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure2/02_load_data.R")   # for load_figure2_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")

TLS_MARKER_VARS_ORDERED <- c(
  "New_TLS_TC", "New_TLS_TC_IM", "Nb_TLS_immature", "Nb_TLS_mature",
  "CD20", "MUM1 IgG", "MUM1 IgA", "CD68", "CD163", "CD66b",
  "CD3", "CD8", "Ki67 PD1", "CD4 Foxp3", "Lag3", "PD1", "PDL1 IC"
)

plot_panel_c <- function(meta, n_per_row = 7) {
  
  df_m <- meta %>%
    select(all_of(TLS_MARKER_VARS_ORDERED), Agg_response, arm) %>%
    reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("Agg_response", "arm")) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    mutate(value = value + 1)
  
  # variable factor levels to follow TLS_MARKER_VARS_ORDERED automatically,
  #
  
  color_groups  <- setNames(rep_2_colors, c("NR", "R"))          # 
  color_groupsb <- setNames(adjustcolor(color_groups, alpha.f = 0.3), c("NR", "R"))
  
  nr_cluster   <- nlevels(df_m$variable)
  n_row        <- ceiling(nr_cluster / n_per_row)
  
  p_values <- df_m %>%
    group_by(variable, arm) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ Agg_response)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(p_value < 0.05,
                          paste0("bold('", format.pval(p_value, digits = 2), "')"),
                          format.pval(p_value, digits = 2)))
  
  max_values <- df_m %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(max_value = max(value) * 1.25, .groups = "drop")
  
  label_data <- merge(p_values, max_values, by = "variable")
  
  ggplot(df_m, aes(x = arm, y = value, color = Agg_response, shape = arm, fill = Agg_response)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                 outlier.colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
    theme_bw() +
    ylab("cells/mm2 or count") + xlab("") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = base_breaks(), labels = prettyNum) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_groupsb) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", nrow = n_row) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10)),
           color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 10))) +
    geom_text(data = label_data, aes(x = arm, y = max_value, label = label),
              parse = TRUE, inherit.aes = FALSE)
}

# --- usage ---
 meta <- load_figure2_data("Figure2/Figure2_metaDat.csv")
 plot_panel_c(meta)
#
```

# ============================================================
# Fig2/code/panel_d_gaba_response.R
# Panel D: response rate by TLS-GABA group, per arm —
# aggregated (R/NR) and, if available, full RECIST (CR/PR/SD/PD).
# ============================================================
source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure2/02_load_data.R")   # for load_figure2_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")

library(patchwork)

GABA_LEVELS <- c("TLS positive Low_GABA", "TLS positive High_GABA", "TLS negative")

plot_panel_d <- function(meta, comp_list = c("Nivo-Ipi", "Nivo", "TKI")) {
  
  df <- meta %>%
    filter(!is.na(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2)) %>%
    mutate(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2 = factor(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, levels = GABA_LEVELS)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  plots <- lapply(comp_list, function(comp) {
    df_arm <- df %>% filter(arm == comp)
    
    a <- plot_contingency(df_arm, c("GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2", "Agg_response"),
                          inverse_factor2 = TRUE, title = paste0("TLS - GABA groups in ", comp),
                          create_labels = FALSE, palette = rep_2_colors)[[1]]  # STILL UNRESOLVED hex
    
   a
  })
  
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1)
}

# --- usage ---
 meta <- load_figure2_data("Figure2/Figure2_metaDat.csv")
 plot_panel_d(meta)

## Panel e-g

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.height=12,fig.width=14}
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(patchwork)

source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure2/02_load_data.R")   # for load_figure2_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")
GABA_LEVELS <- c("TLS positive Low_GABA", "TLS positive High_GABA", "TLS negative")

# --- 
theme_for_ggsurv <- ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 8)   # 
clean_theme_fn   <- function() survminer::theme_cleantable() # 

surv_vars <- list(
  PFS = c("PFS", "PFS_status"),
  OS  = c("OS",  "OS_status"),
  TST = c("TST", "TST_status")
)
comp_list <- c("Nivo-Ipi", "Nivo", "TKI")

declutter_1d<-function(x, min_gap) {
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(x)
  ord <- order(x)
  xs  <- x[ord]
  for (i in 2:length(xs)) {
    if (xs[i] - xs[i - 1] < min_gap) {
      xs[i] <- xs[i - 1] + min_gap
    }
  }
  xs <- xs + (mean(x) - mean(xs))   # re-center so the cluster doesn't drift
  result <- numeric(length(x))
  result[ord] <- xs
  result
}

one_km_plot<-function(data, arm_label, endpoint_label, time_col, event_col,
         group_col = "PRISMA", palette_named) {
  
  d <- data %>%
    filter(arm == arm_label) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(time = all_of(time_col), alive = all_of(event_col), group = all_of(group_col)) %>%
    mutate(time = as.numeric(as.character(time)),
           group = factor(group, levels = names(palette_named))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  pal <- unname(palette_named[levels(droplevels(d$group))])
  
  fit <- survfit(Surv(time, alive) ~ group, data = d)
  
  pl <- ggsurvplot(
    fit, data = d, pval = FALSE, break.time.by = 10, fun = "pct",
    palette = pal, conf.int = FALSE, surv.median.line = "hv",
    legend.labs = levels(droplevels(d$group)),
    risk.table = FALSE, ggtheme = theme_for_ggsurv,
    fontsize = 2, tables.theme = clean_theme_fn(), risk.table.title = ""
  )
  
  p_value <- surv_pvalue(fit = fit, data = d)$pval
  
  pl$plot <- pl$plot +
    ylab(paste0("% ", arm_label)) + xlab("Months") +
    ggtitle(paste0("n= ", nrow(d), "\n", endpoint_label)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # --- median labels: colour matched by GROUP NAME (fix), position
  # 
  med_tab <- surv_median(fit)
  med_tab$group  <- sub("^group=", "", med_tab$strata)
  med_tab <- med_tab[!is.na(med_tab$median), ]      # drop groups whose curve never hits 50%
  med_tab$colour <- palette_named[med_tab$group]     # <- THE FIX: name-keyed, not position-keyed
  
  if (nrow(med_tab) > 0) {
    x_range <- diff(range(d$time, na.rm = TRUE))
    min_gap <- x_range * 0.06   # 6% of this panel's own x-range
    med_tab$x_label <- declutter_1d(med_tab$median, min_gap)
    
    pl$plot <- pl$plot +
      geom_label(
        data = med_tab,
        aes(x = x_label, y = 4, label = round(median, 2)),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        colour = med_tab$colour,
        size = 2,
        label.padding = grid::unit(0.15, "lines")   # 
      )
  }
  
  pl$plot <- pl$plot +
    annotate("text", x = 30, y = 100, size = 3.5,
             label = paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 4)))
  
  pl$plot
}


library(cowplot)   # for get_legend()

build_gaba_legend <- function(palette_named) {
  dummy_df <- data.frame(
    group = factor(names(palette_named), levels = names(palette_named)),
    x = 1, y = 1
  )
  
  legend_plot <- ggplot(dummy_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = palette_named, name = NULL) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))
  
  cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
}


plot_panel_efg <- function(meta, comp_list = c("Nivo-Ipi", "Nivo", "TKI")) {
  
  meta <- meta %>%
    filter(!is.na(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2)) %>%
    mutate(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2 = factor(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, levels = GABA_LEVELS))
  
  all_plots <- lapply(comp_list, function(comp) {
    lapply(names(surv_vars), function(ep) {
      one_km_plot(
        data = meta, arm_label = comp, endpoint_label = ep,
        time_col = surv_vars[[ep]][1], event_col = surv_vars[[ep]][2],
        group_col = "GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2",
        palette_named = gaba_group_colors
      )
    })
  }) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)
  
  grid <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = length(comp_list))
  legend_grob <- build_gaba_legend(gaba_group_colors)
  
  grid / patchwork::wrap_elements(full = legend_grob) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(20, 1))   # legend strip is thin relative to the 3x3 grid
}

# --- usage ---
 meta <- load_figure2_data("Figure2/Figure2_metaDat.csv")
# pdf("Fig2/output/panel_efg.pdf", width = 20, height = 8, onefile = TRUE)
plot_panel_efg(meta)
```
